Vast amphitheatre contiguous to the palace. Royal palace with throne on the right. Serragli of fairs in prospect. Gates in the bottom, joining the two ends of the amphitheatre. To this one descends from a high hill surrounded, and adorns of magnificent factories. From the top of the same road Merodate, king of Sarmati over sumptuous chariot pulled by four fair domites. It is preceded by a march of military instructions: by his Guards, and by many Schiavi mori, who are led into wild chains, Nani, and Giants; wedding gifts, which to the real Tomiri destines the uncultivated genius of the northern extravagant monarch.
